critique.light-gone-blank: The light went before you'd painted a thing.
critique.light-gone: The light went before you could finish it.
critique.original: An original. It's yours, whatever anyone says.
critique.great-muddy: Lovely work. A cleaner mix and it would sing.
critique.great: It looks just like the real thing.
critique.unrecognisable: Hmm... is this meant to be {{subject}}?
critique.muddy: The colors have gone muddy. Take more care at the palette.
critique.messy: It's nice, but there are stray marks all around it.
critique.shape: The colors are right, but the shape isn't quite {{subject}} yet.
critique.good: Very nice! A few colors aren't quite right, but it's charming.
critique.colors: That's the right shape, but the colors aren't there yet.
critique.sable.light-gone-blank: You ran out of light before you started. Everyone does once. Start smaller.
critique.sable.original: An original. Don't let anyone price it for you. Including me.
critique.sable.light-gone: You ran out of light. Everyone does. Paint the big shapes first.
critique.sable.great-muddy: Good bones. The mixing's muddy at the edges. Fix that and I'd hang it.
critique.sable.great: ...I'd hang that. I don't say that.
critique.sable.unrecognisable: Is that {{subject}}? Don't answer. Try again.
critique.sable.muddy: Your colors went muddy. Mud is just a color that got distracted.
critique.sable.messy: Stray marks. Every one you leave, the eye trips over.
critique.sable.shape: Right colors, wrong shape. Look at {{subject}} longer than you paint it.
critique.sable.good: Close. A few of those colors are guesses. Stop guessing.
critique.sable.colors: The shape's there. Now earn the colors.

yard.watch.ask: Sable's working the canvas in thin washes. Stay and watch for a while?

yard.watch.again: Sable's lost in the painting. Best not to break the spell twice.
shop.counter: Welcome to the art supply shop.
shop.on-trust: A note on the till: "Take what you need. Money in the jar. -S"
commission.not-good-enough: It's lovely... but I was hoping for {{quality}}. Could you try again?

commission.lapsed: {{npc}}'s commission for a painting of {{item}} has lapsed.

commission.delivered: My {{item}} painting! It's just what I asked for. Here's {{reward}}g, thank you.
commission.needs.varnished: It's beautiful... but I'd hoped for one with a varnish on it. It'll last longer. Could you finish it?
commission.needs.glazed: Lovely! Only, I'd hoped for a glaze, that deep, layered colour, on the shaded parts. Could you try one with the glazing done?

tool.glaze.help: Glaze (T): a thin dark wash over paint that's already down. The dotted cells in the reference want one.
tool.highlight.help: Highlight (H): a dab of thick, light paint. Put highlights on last: painting beside one smears it.
technique.explain.glaze: New on this canvas: glazing. The darker, shaded cells in the reference are glazed. Paint the colour, then glaze over it (Glaze tool, T).
technique.explain.highlight: New on this canvas: highlights. A few bright spots take a dab of thick paint (Highlight tool, H). Do them last: painting beside one smears it.
technique.needs-paint: The {{tool}} goes over paint: paint the cell first.
technique.smeared: Smeared a highlight! Highlights go on last.
item.linen.description: Fine linen, stretched and primed. Paints like any canvas, but only on linen can a painting become a Masterpiece.
setup.linen-hover: Paint on a linen canvas. Only linen can make a Masterpiece: an iridium painting, five stars, Inspired, with its glazes and highlights in place.
sable.masterpiece-gift: ...Oh.$h#$b#Do you know what this is? Most painters go their whole lives without one of these. I'm hanging it where I can see it from the counter.$l
skill.level-up.varnish: Varnish: a cabinet that cures paintings to a finer finish
skill.level-up.linen: Linen canvases: the only ones a Masterpiece can be painted on

married.farm-painting: I was out at the patio easel yesterday while you worked.$h#$b#It's the farm. Our farm. Take it before I start fixing the sky again.
married.wall.0: Your {{painting}} catches the morning light where you hung it. I keep stopping to look.$h
married.wall.1: I looked at your {{painting}} over breakfast. You've got braver with your colours.$h
married.wall.2: Your {{painting}}... I'd have hung it a little higher. But I'd have hung it.$u
married.wall.3: Sometimes I forget your {{painting}} is yours and start critiquing it. Then I remember, and keep critiquing it.$h

summit.arrive: I saw the easel from the path. I had a feeling it'd be you.
summit.arrive.married: There you are. I had a feeling I'd find you up here.
summit.book: I brought the book. I hope you don't mind. I wanted to look through all of it with you, in one go.
summit.pages: Sable turns the pages slowly: the town in four seasons, the things you grew, the far places, the fish nobody believes in, the faces.
summit.faces: You painted all of us. You even painted me, and I never know what to do with my hands.
summit.julian: Julian would write three pages about this book. And he'd mean every word, which is worse.
summit.proud: When you walked into my shop, you'd never held a brush. Now you've filled a whole book. I'm proud of you. Really.
summit.proud.married: When you walked into my shop, you'd never held a brush. Now look at you. I'm so proud of you. I love you, you know.
summit.last-page: It needs one more page, though. This one. Every good book should end somewhere high up.

julian.review.iridium: {{title}}. The light is right, the colour is right, and I resent not finding the flaw.#$b#One note: you stopped short of the edges. Paint all the way to them next time.$u
julian.review.gold: {{title}}. Confident colour, honest light.#$b#The composition is a little polite. Be ruder.$7
julian.review.plain: {{title}}. The colours argue in the middle, and the edges wander.#$b#But you saw something, and that's the part nobody can teach.$0
julian.buy.ask: Julian glances at the bag on your shoulder. "Anything in there for sale? I buy one painting a season. Only one, so I choose carefully."
julian.buy.pick: Sell a painting to Julian (twice the price, once a season)
julian.buy.masterpiece: {{painting}}. Oh.#$b#I don't say that often. Here: {{price}}g, and it's still a bargain. It's going on my wall in the city, where people will ask about it.$h
julian.buy.iridium: {{painting}}. I've been looking for a flaw for a full minute. {{price}}g, before I change my mind about being impressed.$h
julian.buy.gold: {{painting}}. Good. Better than good, in places. {{price}}g. Keep going in this direction.$0
julian.buy.plain: {{painting}}. It's unfinished in all the right ways. I'm buying it to see where you go next. {{price}}g.$0
julian.review.none: There's nothing of yours in the book. A critic can't review an empty wall.$u
julian.event.sable-dinner: Stay for dinner, Julian. The farmer cooks.$u#$b#Badly.$u
contest.invite: The painting contest. One entry each, judged when Lewis judges the grange.#$b#Show me what you've brought.$7
contest.pick: Enter a painting in the contest
contest.thanks: {{painting}}. It goes on the easel until the judging.#$b#Come back to me after Lewis has done his rounds.$0
contest.entered: {{painting}} is on the easel. Don't fuss with it.#$b#Come back after the grange judging.$u
contest.no-painting: The painting contest. One entry each, and you've brought nothing to enter.#$b#Next year, then. I'll be here, regrettably.$u
contest.no-entry: The judging's over, and you didn't enter.#$b#Next year. I'm told it comes around.$u
contest.result.1: First place. {{score}} out of 100.#$b#I don't say this often, so listen: it's the best thing in the tent.#$b#{{tokens}} star tokens, and the blue ribbon. Your painting back, too. Hang it somewhere people walk past.$l
contest.result.2: Second place, {{score}} out of 100. {{rival}} beat you, narrowly.#$b#{{tokens}} star tokens and the red ribbon. Here's your painting back.$7
contest.result.3: Third place, {{score}} out of 100. {{rival}} took first.#$b#{{tokens}} star tokens and the yellow ribbon. And your painting.$0
contest.result.4: Fourth, {{score}} out of 100. {{rival}} took first. It happens to everyone, even me. Once.#$b#{{tokens}} star tokens for entering. Here's your painting back.$s
contest.after: The contest's done for the year. I'm going to stand very still and hope nobody asks me to judge the pies.$u

stall.closed: A little skiff, painted with moons, is tied up below the dock. Nobody's aboard yet.
stall.greeting: Out on the water's the only place the light's worth anything tonight. What can I do for you?
stall.lupini: Three boats along. The only other painter in the valley who works at night.#$b#We don't talk. We nod.$h
stall.nothing: Nothing in your bag I'd want for the boat.#$b#Bring me something strange: a night or a storm, the desert, a monster, one of the legendary fish.
stall.full: That's three tonight. Any more and the boat sinks.#$b#Come back tomorrow night.$h
stall.pick: Sell a painting to Sable (half as much again)
stall.sold: {{painting}}. Yes. {{price}}g, and it goes on the boat where people can see it.$h
stall.sold-last: {{painting}}. {{price}}g. And that's the boat full for tonight.$h
stall.shop: Moonlit Frames. One a night: each takes me a week.
gallery.portfolio.book: Your portfolio book has come out of the back room for the evening, open on its lectern. Someone's paging through it.
gallery.portfolio.sketches: Your portfolio book has nothing in it yet, so Sable has laid a pile of your sketches on its lectern.
gallery.portfolio.portrait.lewis: Is this me? Hm. You've given me more hair than I've had in years. I approve.$h
gallery.portfolio.portrait.leah: That's me! You got the way I squint at things. Nobody ever notices that.$h
gallery.portfolio.portrait.elliott: My likeness, caught mid-reverie. I may weep. I may write about weeping.$h
gallery.portfolio.portrait.haley: Wait, that's me? ...Okay, the lighting's actually really flattering. I want a copy.$h
gallery.portfolio.portrait.robin: That's me in my work clothes! You even got the sawdust. Sort of.$h
gallery.portfolio.portrait.evelyn: Oh, my. You painted me with my roses. George, come and look!$h
gallery.portfolio.portrait.george: Hmph. That's me.#$b#...Don't tell anyone I like it.
gallery.portfolio.portrait.emily: My portrait! Look at the colours you put round me. It's like you saw my aura.$h
